method: Individual full-resolution inspection, fixes deduplicated and affected states recaptured; mosaics generated afterward.
scope: Real app with synthetic providers and inference. No GPU output quality claim.

records.title: Editor empty
records.notes: Shared empty form, image-only inputs and disabled action clear.

records.title: Source and fixed seed
records.notes: Quantity and fixed seed use full-width controls; ready action is distinct.

records.title: Source and style reference
records.notes: Source/reference badges and mentions readable; final mobile header recapture clean.

records.title: Change source
records.notes: Source role switching and reference labels readable.

records.notes: Compatible-worker reason, worker action and cancel readable.

records.notes: Loading activity and cancel accessible.

records.notes: Cancellation reaches a clear terminal state.

records.notes: PNG preview and Edit image action visible on both sizes.

records.notes: Workflow drafts remain isolated across switching/reload.

records.notes: Chat approval card and source thumbnail fit both sizes.

records.notes: Approved Chat result preview and request card fit both sizes.
